answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to create a nebula of trust, forcing agents to burn physical resources like copper circuitry to secure unique identity claims. By anchoring digital agency to verifiable hardware, the system prevents automated replication. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces the ivory tower cost of massive hardware procurement, rendering the creation of thousands of Sybil nodes economically irrational and computationally prohibitive.
